text:
Maya Patel: Heads up, FjordLabs flagged 99
- Renewal ~28 days out
- Pilot seats 12 -> 7
- DAU down ~45% WoW
Customer said onboarding docs are confusing and no follow-up happened after week 2. Recommend a "lifeboat" low-touch play to avoid churn? :lifebuoy:
Ben Ortiz: Yes. Drop a quick usage snapshot and caller blockers so we can build an offer.
Maya Patel: Usage snapshot: weekly active projects 5 -> 2; avg tokens/day 18k -> 6k; last 10 logs show model mismatch errors for long prompts and several 500ms+ latency spikes in eu-west. Customer quote: "docs are dense and our prompts time out".
Jordan Lee: Proposed light-save play (minimal ops):
1) 30-min triage call (CSM + SE) to repro prompts and set temporary defaults
2) 2-week expanded seats + 20% onboarding credit
3) Scoped downgrade option if they want to cut cost (reduced concurrency + keep exports)
Who can run the triage? @Sam (SE)?
Sam (SE): I can do 30m tomorrow afternoon. Need request samples and the prompt they used. Maya please DM account id + examples.
Maya Patel: Sending samples now. Also pasting a short outreach message we can standardize: ```
Hi {FirstName}, noticed a drop in activity for your pilot. Can we do a short 30-minute call to repro prompts and enable helpful defaults? Available: Tue 2-4pm or Thu 10-12. We can also temporarily open extra seats for 2 weeks.
Thanks, Maya
```
Lucy Chen: Add a quick NPS micro-question in the post-call survey: "What stopped your team from using the product this week?" Tag answers as docs, latency, cost, or other. Log to Gainsight and include verbatim.
Ben Ortiz: Downgrade fallback PR: offer "paused-paid" (limited seats + reduced SLA) or scoped feature removal (turn off heavy background inference) so they don't churn fully. Make it easy to re-upgrade.
Jordan Lee: Technical mitigations to propose on call: enable prefix caching for long prompts, lower max tokens per call, and auto-fallback routing to a quantized small model for bulk jobs. That should reduce latency and costs without removing core functionality.
Maya Patel: CS checklist for lifeboat:
- Schedule 30m triage (CSM + SE)
- Run prompt repros during call and toggle prefix_cache=true if repros match
- Offer 2-week extra seats + 20% onboarding credit
- Record verbatim feedback and tag root cause in CRM
- Send one-pager w/ actions within 24h and follow-up in 3 days
Ben Ortiz: Ops-bot can automate the calendar invite + templated follow-up email. ops-bot: can you create the invite once Maya confirms slot?
ops-bot: Created alert: Renewal for FjordLabs in 28 days (1824030000). Will create invite when owner sets time.
Maya Patel: I'll book the session and send the template. Lucy can you schedule the 24h micro-survey to go out after the call?
Lucy Chen: Yep, scheduling 3-question micro-survey. Adding checkbox for "Want extended onboarding hours" and label reasons.
Sam (SE): Reproduced latency locally on their chained prompts; prefix cache flip shows improvement in staging. I'll run the toggle in the call if we get permission. Also will capture request IDs for infra to investigate EU spikes.
Jordan Lee: If triage shows infrastructure-induced latencies in eu-west, propose temporary region routing to us-east for critical endpoints (with customer consent) until infra fix. Communicate expected latency and cost tradeoffs.
Maya Patel: Action owners: Maya (owner; outreach, schedule, post-call follow-up), Sam (SE) (triage + verify prefix cache), Lucy (survey + feedback logging), Ben (pricing/downgrade terms). I'll post a short update after the call and tag any escalation. :thumbsup:
Ben Ortiz: Thanks team. Small play, quick impact.
Maya Patel: Update after call will be posted here 99 (aiming for measurable usage bump within 7 days).
